RECORDS.description_main:
NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System Default Credentials Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the product installer. The issue results from the use of default MySQL credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-22755.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System Default Credentials Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.\n\nThe specific flaw exists within the product installer. The issue results from the use of default MySQL credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-22755."}]}

An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-22868."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System UpLoadServlet Unrestricted File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the UpLoadServlet class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-22923.

RECORDS.description_main: A vulnerability was found in Netgear WN604 up to 20240710. It has been rated as problematic. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /downloadFile.php of the component Web Interface. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before allocating a buffer. RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR RAX30 AX2400系列路由器在1.0.9.90版本之前存在网络配置错误
RECORDS.solution: 升级到1.0.9.90或更高版本，或手动禁用WAN接口的IPv6功能，并仅允许必要的流量通过WAN接口。
RECORDS.description_main: A network misconfiguration is present in versions prior to 1.0.9.90 of the NETGEAR RAX30 AX2400 series of routers. IPv6 is enabled for the WAN interface by default on these devices. While there are firewall restrictions in place that define access restrictions for IPv4 traffic, these restrictions do not appear to be applied to the WAN interface for IPv6. This allows arbitrary access to any services running on the device that may be inadvertently listening via IPv6, such as the SSH and Telnet servers spawned on ports 22 and 23 by default. This misconfiguration could allow an attacker to interact with services only intended to be accessible by clients on the local network.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: NETGEAR RAX30 AX2400系列路由器在1.0.9.90版本之前存在网络配置错误。这些设备的WAN接口默认启用IPv6。尽管已经设置了针对IPv4流量的防火墙限制访问限制，但这些限制似乎未应用于IPv6的WAN接口。这就允许任意访问设备上任意通过IPv6意外监听的服务，例如默认端口22和23上生成的SSH和Telnet服务器。这种配置错误可能允许攻击者与仅应由局域网客户端访问的服务进行交互。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A network misconfiguration is present in versions prior to 1.0.9.90 of the NETGEAR RAX30 AX2400 series of routers. IPv6 is enabled for the WAN interface by default on these devices. While there are firewall restrictions in place that define access restrictions for IPv4 traffic, these restrictions do not appear to be applied to the WAN interface for IPv6. This allows arbitrary access to any services running on the device that may be inadvertently listening via IPv6, such as the SSH and Telnet servers spawned on ports 22 and 23 by default. This misconfiguration could allow an attacker to interact with services only intended to be accessible by clients on the local network."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Netgear RAX43 version 1.0.3.96存在硬编码凭据
RECORDS.solution: 为避免此漏洞，请升级到Netgear RAX43的最新版本。同时，推荐使用不同的密码保护配置备份文件，以增加安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: Netgear RAX43 version 1.0.3.96 makes use of hardcoded credentials. It does not appear that normal users are intended to be able to manipulate configuration backups due to the fact that they are encrypted. This encryption is accomplished via a password-protected zip file with a hardcoded password (RAX50w!a4udk). By unzipping the configuration using this password, a user can reconfigure settings not intended to be manipulated, re-zip the configuration, and restore a backup causing these settings to be changed.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Netgear RAX43 version 1.0.3.96存在硬编码凭据。由于备份文件被加密，通常用户无法修改配置备份。但是，备份文件使用一个硬编码的密码（RAX50w!a4udk）进行加密。用户可以使用该密码解压缩文件，重新配置设置，再压缩配置文件并恢复备份，从而更改不应该被更改的设置。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Netgear RAX43 version 1.0.3.96 makes use of hardcoded credentials. RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R6400 和 R6700 路由器固件版本 1.0.4.98 存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 已发布更新程序修复此漏洞。建议用户立即更新他们的固件版本至最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R6400 and R6700 firmware version 1.0.4.98 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the upnpd service, which listens on UDP port 1900 by default. A crafted MX header field in an SSDP message can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11851.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许网络相邻的攻击者在受影响的 NETGEAR R6400 和 R6700 路由器安装上执行任意代码。此漏洞不需要身份验证即可利用。具体漏洞存在于 upnpd 服务内，默认监听UDP端口1900。在 SSDP 消息的 MX 标头字段中植入构造的数据，可触发基于固定长度堆栈缓冲区的溢出。攻击者可以利用此漏洞以 root 的身份执行代码。漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-11851。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R6400 and R6700 firmware version 1.0.4.98 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the upnpd service, which listens on UDP port 1900 by default. A crafted MX header field in an SSDP message can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11851."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System 1.6.0.26. RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 公司已发布了针对此漏洞的补丁程序，请及时更新。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of multiple NETGEAR routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from incorrect string matching logic when accessing protected pages. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-13313.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from incorrect string matching logic when accessing protected pages. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-13313."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
NETGEAR R7800 net-cgi Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R7800 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of the soap_block_table file. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated data structure. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-13055.

When parsing the strings file, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.




. Was ZDI-CAN-13709.

NETGEAR Multiple Routers httpd Missing Authentication for Critical Function Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of multiple NETGEAR routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to system configuration information. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-13708.

RECORDS.description_main: NETGEAR WAC104 devices before 1.0.4.15 are affected by an authentication bypass vulnerability in /usr/sbin/mini_httpd, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to invoke any action by adding the &currentsetting.htm substring to the HTTP query, a related issue to CVE-2020-27866. This directly allows the attacker to change the web UI password, and eventually to enable debug mode (telnetd) and gain a shell on the device as the admin limited-user account (however, escalation to root is simple because of weak permissions on the /etc/ directory).

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR路由器上的Circle Parental Control服务更新过程存在远程代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 推荐用户更新受影响的路由器的固件版本，可在NETGEAR的支持网站上找到最新版本。此外，可以删除circled守护进程，或者将其进一步配置为使用预共享密钥或证书验证来保护更新。
RECORDS.description_main: The update process of the Circle Parental Control Service on various NETGEAR routers allows remote attackers to achieve remote code execution as root via a MitM attack. While the parental controls themselves are not enabled by default on the routers, the Circle update daemon, circled, is enabled by default. This daemon connects to Circle and NETGEAR to obtain version information and updates to the circled daemon and its filtering database. However, database updates from NETGEAR are unsigned and downloaded via cleartext HTTP. As such, an attacker with the ability to perform a MitM attack on the device can respond to circled update requests with a crafted, compressed database file, the extraction of which gives the attacker the ability to overwrite executable files with attacker-controlled code. This affects R6400v2 1.0.4.106, R6700 1.0.2.16, R6700v3 1.0.4.106, R6900 1.0.2.16, R6900P 1.3.2.134, R7000 1.0.11.123, R7000P 1.3.2.134, R7850 1.0.5.68, R7900 1.0.4.38, R8000 1.0.4.68, and RS400 1.5.0.68.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 各种NETGEAR路由器上的Circle Parental Control服务的更新过程存在远程攻击者可以通过MitM攻击实现以root身份执行远程代码的漏洞。虽然路由器上的家长控制本身默认情况下未启用，但Circle更新守护程序circled默认情况下已启用。此守护程序连接到Circle和NETGEAR以获取版本信息、更新circled守护程序及其过滤数据库。然而，NETGEAR的数据库更新未签名，并通过明文HTTP下载。因此，能够对设备执行MitM攻击的攻击者可以用经过编造的、压缩的数据库文件响应circled的更新请求，其解压缩可以使攻击者能够用攻击者控制的代码覆盖可执行文件。这影响到R6400v2 1.0.4.106、R6700 1.0.2.16、R6700v3 1.0.4.106、R6900 1.0.2.16、R6900P 1.3.2.134、R7000 1.0.11.123、R7000P 1.3.2.134、R7850 1.0.5.68、R7900 1.0.4.38、R8000 1.0.4.68和RS400 1.5.0.68。

RECORDS.description_main: Netgear Nighthawk R6700 version 1.0.4.120 makes use of a hardcoded credential. It does not appear that normal users are intended to be able to manipulate configuration backups due to the fact that they are encrypted/obfuscated. By extracting the configuration using readily available public tools, a user can reconfigure settings not intended to be manipulated, repackage the configuration, and restore a backup causing these settings to be changed.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Netgear Nighthawk R6700版本1.0.4.120存在硬编码凭证漏洞。由于配置备份是加密/混淆的，正常用户似乎无意修改配置备份。然而，通过使用现成的公共工具提取配置，用户可以重新配置未被设计修改的设置，重新打包配置，并恢复备份以更改这些设置。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Netgear Nighthawk R6700 version 1.0.4.120 makes use of a hardcoded credential. It does not appear that normal users are intended to be able to manipulate configuration backups due to the fact that they are encrypted/obfuscated. RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 已发布 R6700 路由器更新，修复了该漏洞。如果您是受影响的用户，请尽快下载并安装更新。另外，建议关闭 UPnP 服务以避免被攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UPnP service, which listens on TCP port 5000. A crafted UPnP message can be used to bypass authentication. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9642.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞存在于 NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 路由器的 UPnP 服务中，使得网络相邻的攻击者可以绕过认证。利用这个漏洞不需要经过认证。利用一个精心制作的 UPnP 消息就可以绕过认证。攻击者可以将此漏洞与其他漏洞结合使用，以 root 用户的身份执行任意代码。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UPnP service, which listens on TCP port 5000. A crafted UPnP message can be used to bypass authentication. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9642."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R6700路由器认证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR建议所有用户及时升级受影响产品的固件到最新版本，并尽快启用远程管理功能的SSL连接，以免被攻击者利用此漏洞入侵网络。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the UPnP service, which listens on TCP port 5000 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9643.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 这个漏洞允许网络邻近的攻击者绕过受影响的NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58路由器上的身份验证。虽然需要身份验证才能利用此漏洞，但现有的身份验证机制可以被绕过。具体漏洞存在于UPnP服务中，默认情况下在TCP端口5000上监听。问题源于在将用户提供的数据复制到固定长度的基于堆栈的缓冲区之前未对其长度进行适当验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root的上下文中执行代码。ZDI-CAN-9643。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the UPnP service, which listens on TCP port 5000 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9643."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58路由器存在下载文件漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR推出了更新软件的补丁，建议用户及时更新路由器软件以修复此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to compromise the integrity of downloaded information on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the downloading of files via HTTPS. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the certificate presented by the server. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9647.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许网络相邻的攻击者破坏受影响的NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58路由器上下载信息的完整性。不需要身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体缺陷存在于通过HTTPS下载文件时。问题源于服务器呈现证书时缺乏适当的验证。攻击者可以利用这个漏洞与其他漏洞结合起来，在root上下文中执行任意代码。编号为ZDI-CAN-9647。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to compromise the integrity of downloaded information on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the certificate presented by the server. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9647."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R6700路由器任意代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了修复程序，请及时更新路由器的固件版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of string table file uploads. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the web server. Was ZDI-CAN-9767.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许邻近网络攻击者在受影响的NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58路由器上执行任意代码。攻击者无需进行身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体漏洞存在于字符串表文件上传处理中。问题源于在将用户提供的数据复制到基于固定长度的堆缓冲区之前，缺少对其长度进行适当验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在web服务器上执行代码。ZDI-CAN-9767。

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58路由器的任意代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 尽快升级路由器至最新版本并关闭对外网的文件共享。

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR Orbi 路由器存在远程代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 用户应立即更新到最新的固件版本，并更改 root 账户和 Web-admin 组件的密码，确保网络安全。
RECORDS.description_main: An issue was discovered on NETGEAR Orbi Tri-Band Business WiFi Add-on Satellite (SRS60) AC3000 V2.5.1.106, Outdoor Satellite (RBS50Y) V2.5.1.106, and Pro Tri-Band Business WiFi Router (SRR60) AC3000 V2.5.1.106. RECORDS.title_zh: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.
RECORDS.solution: 更新UPnP规范以禁止接受发送到不同网络段的投递URL的订阅请求。
RECORDS.description_main: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在2020年4月17日之前，开放互联互通基金会UPnP规范未禁止接受发送到不同网络段的投递URL的订阅请求，而完全合格的事件订阅URL，也就是CallStranger问题。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue."}]}

RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR已发布了一个软件更新来修复此漏洞。建议用户尽快安装最新的固件更新。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9703.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许邻近网络攻击者绕过网络中受影响的NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58路由器的身份验证。利用此漏洞不需要身份验证。具体漏洞位于httpd服务中，默认情况下该服务在TCP端口80上监听。该问题源于在将用户提供的数据复制到固定长度的基于堆栈的缓冲区之前缺乏正确的数据长度验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root的上下文中执行代码。ZDI-CAN-9703。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9703."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700 V1.0.4.84_10.0.58 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of string table file uploads. A crafted gui_region in a string table file can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the web server. Was ZDI-CAN-9756.

A crafted gui_region in a string table file can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the web server. Was ZDI-CAN-9756."}]}

RECORDS.solution: 建议用户立即升级到 1.0.0.210 版本及以上，以修复该安全漏洞。同时，用户也应该注意设备的安全管理，避免遭受黑客攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: NETGEAR EX7700 devices before 1.0.0.210 are affected by incorrect configuration of security settings.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: NETGEAR EX7700 设备在 1.0.0.210 版本之前存在安全设置错误，可能导致安全性受到威胁。

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR 设备受敏感信息披露影响
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 已经发布了更新版本，用户应该升级到版本号不低于 6.5.5.24 的系统来修复此问题。
RECORDS.description_main: Certain NETGEAR devices are affected by disclosure of sensitive information. This affects WC7500 before 6.5.5.24, WC7600 before 6.5.5.24, WC7600v2 before 6.5.5.24, and WC9500 before 6.5.5.24.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: WC7500 版本号低于 6.5.5.24、WC7600 版本号低于 6.5.5.24、WC7600v2 版本号低于 6.5.5.24 以及 WC9500 版本号低于 6.5.5.24 的 NETGEAR 设备受影响，而且可能会披露敏感信息。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Certain NETGEAR devices are affected by disclosure of sensitive information. This affects WC7500 before 6.5.5.24, WC7600 before 6.5.5.24, WC7600v2 before 6.5.5.24, and WC9500 before 6.5.5.24."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR Orbi路由器2.5.1.16版本存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 尽快安装NETGEAR发布的升级补丁，最新版本号为2.5.1.17。另外，建议对路由器进行额外的网络安全措施，例如强密码、关闭远程管理功能等。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR Orbi 2.5.1.16 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UA_Parser utility. A crafted Host Name option in a DHCP request can trigger execution of a system call composed from a user-supplied string. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11076.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许邻近网络攻击者在受影响的NETGEAR Orbi2.5.1.16 路由器上执行任意代码。攻击者无需身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体漏洞存在于UA_Parser实用程序中。在DHCP请求中，一个精心设计的Host Name选项可以触发由用户提供的字符串组成的系统调用执行。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root上下文中执行代码。该漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-11076。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR Orbi 2.5.1.16 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UA_Parser utility. A crafted Host Name option in a DHCP request can trigger execution of a system call composed from a user-supplied string. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11076."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR路由器身份验证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR修补程序已提供。请访问NETGEAR支持网站，并下载适用于受影响产品的最新固件更新，以获得最新修补程序。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6020, R6080, R6120, R6220, R6260, R6700v2, R6800, R6900v2, R7450, JNR3210, WNR2020, Nighthawk AC2100, and Nighthawk AC2400 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from incorrect string matching logic when accessing protected pages. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11355.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许网络相邻的攻击者在影响NETGEAR R6020、R6080、R6120、R6220、R6260、R6700v2、R6800、R6900v2、R7450、JNR3210、WNR2020、Nighthawk AC2100和Nighthawk AC2400路由器的安装中绕过身份验证。利用此漏洞不需要身份验证。该漏洞存在于mini_httpd服务中，该服务默认监听TCP端口80。该问题在访问受保护页面时出现了错误的字符串匹配逻辑。攻击者可以结合其他漏洞利用此漏洞在root上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-11355。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6020, R6080, R6120, R6220, R6260, R6700v2, R6800, R6900v2, R7450, JNR3210, WNR2020, Nighthawk AC2100, and Nighthawk AC2400 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from incorrect string matching logic when accessing protected pages. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11355."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR路由器多个型号存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR已发布修复程序，建议用户尽快进行更新。建议管理员限制对路由器的网络访问，并且务必使用强密码并定期更改密码。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R6020, R6080, R6120, R6220, R6260, R6700v2, R6800, R6900v2, R7450, JNR3210, WNR2020, Nighthawk AC2100, and Nighthawk AC2400 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. When parsing the funjsq_access_token parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11653.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许附近的攻击者在受影响的NETGEAR R6020、R6080、R6120、R6220、R6260、R6700v2、R6800、R6900v2、R7450、JNR3210、WNR2020、Nighthawk AC2100、Nighthawk AC2400路由器上执行任意代码。尽管需要进行身份验证才能利用此漏洞，但现有的身份验证机制可以被绕过。具体缺陷存在于默认情况下监听TCP端口80的mini_httpd服务中。在解析funjsq_access_token参数时，该进程在使用用户提供的字符串之前未正确验证其有效性，并将其用于执行系统调用。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root的上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号ZDI-CAN-11653。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR R6020, R6080, R6120, R6220, R6260, R6700v2, R6800, R6900v2, R7450, JNR3210, WNR2020, Nighthawk AC2100, and Nighthawk AC2400 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. When parsing the funjsq_access_token parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11653."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1 路由器认证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: Netgear 已发布了修复程序，请尽快更新受影响的设备。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from improper state tracking in the password recovery process. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11365.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 这个漏洞使得网络相邻的攻击者可以绕过 NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1 路由器的认证。攻击者无需进行认证即可利用此漏洞，该问题源于 mini_httpd 服务中的错误状态跟踪，该服务默认监听 TCP 端口 80。攻击者可利用此漏洞与其他漏洞结合使用来在 root 上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-11365。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mini_httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from improper state tracking in the password recovery process. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-11365."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR R7450路由器存在敏感信息泄漏漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR推出了更新版本1.2.0.64，该版本修复了此漏洞。建议用户尽快更新到此版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SOAP API endpoint, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-11559.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞使得网络邻接攻击者能够在受影响的NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1路由器上披露敏感信息。利用此漏洞不需要身份验证。问题存在于SOAP API终端点中，该终端点默认监听TCP端口80。问题源于缺乏适当的访问控制。攻击者可以利用这个漏洞来披露存储的凭据，导致进一步的攻击。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-11559。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NETGEAR R7450 1.2.0.62_1.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SOAP API endpoint, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-11559."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR Nighthawk R7000 SIP ALG 实现存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 已经发布了针对这个问题的修复版本。建议受影响用户立即进行升级。此外，用户可以关闭 SIP ALG，或使用其他防火墙和网络设备来保护网络。
RECORDS.description_main: The SIP ALG implementation on NETGEAR Nighthawk R7000 1.0.9.64_10.2.64 devices allows remote attackers to communicate with arbitrary TCP and UDP services on a victim's intranet machine, if the victim visits an attacker-controlled web site with a modern browser, aka NAT Slipstreaming. This occurs because the ALG takes action based on an IP packet with an initial REGISTER substring in the TCP data, and the correct intranet IP address in the subsequent Via header, without properly considering that connection progress and fragmentation affect the meaning of the packet data.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: NETGEAR Nighthawk R7000 1.0.9.64_10.2.64 设备上的 SIP ALG 实现存在漏洞。攻击者可以通过一个现代浏览器，诱使受害者访问一个攻击者控制的网站，从而与受害者内部网络机器上的任意 TCP 和 UDP 服务进行通信，华丽实现自然滑动。这是因为该 ALG 基于 TCP 数据中的 REGISTER 子字符串的 IP 数据包采取行动，并且在随后的 Via 标头中正确考虑了内部网络 IP 地址，而没有正确考虑连接进度和分段影响数据包数据的含义。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The SIP ALG implementation on NETGEAR Nighthawk R7000 1.0.9.64_10.2.64 devices allows remote attackers to communicate with arbitrary TCP and UDP services on a victim's intranet machine, if the victim visits an attacker-controlled web site with a modern browser, aka NAT Slipstreaming. This occurs because the ALG takes action based on an IP packet with an initial REGISTER substring in the TCP data, and the correct intranet IP address in the subsequent Via header, without properly considering that connection progress and fragmentation affect the meaning of the packet data."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR 设备的 upnpd 存在远程 (LAN) 攻击者可以通过栈缓冲区溢出执行任意代码的漏洞。

This affects R6400v2 V1.0.4.102_10.0.75, R6400 V1.0.1.62_1.0.41, R7000P V1.3.2.126_10.1.66, XR300 V1.0.3.50_10.3.36, R8000 V1.0.4.62, R8300 V1.0.2.136, R8500 V1.0.2.136, R7300DST V1.0.0.74, R7850 V1.0.5.64, R7900 V1.0.4.30, RAX20 V1.0.2.64, RAX80 V1.0.3.102, and R6250 V1.0.4.44.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"upnpd on certain NETGEAR devices allows remote (LAN) attackers to execute arbitrary code via a stack-based buffer overflow. This affects R6400v2 V1.0.4.102_10.0.75, R6400 V1.0.1.62_1.0.41, R7000P V1.3.2.126_10.1.66, XR300 V1.0.3.50_10.3.36, R8000 V1.0.4.62, R8300 V1.0.2.136, R8500 V1.0.2.136, R7300DST V1.0.0.74, R7850 V1.0.5.64, R7900 V1.0.4.30, RAX20 V1.0.2.64, RAX80 V1.0.3.102, and R6250 V1.0.4.44."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 存在密码认证哈希算法安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 已发布 v2.6.0.44 版本修复了该漏洞，请尽快升级设备固件以避免受到攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: The hashing algorithm implemented for NSDP password authentication on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices was found to be insecure, allowing attackers (with access to a network capture) to quickly generate multiple collisions to generate valid passwords, or infer some parts of the original.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 研究发现，NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备上实现的 NSDP 密码认证哈希算法存在安全漏洞，攻击者可以通过网络捕获快速生成多个碰撞以生成有效密码，或推断出部分原始密码。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The hashing algorithm implemented for NSDP password authentication on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices was found to be insecure, allowing attackers (with access to a network capture) to quickly generate multiple collisions to generate valid passwords, or infer some parts of the original."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备中的 CSRF 防护机制存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR 已经发布了修复该漏洞的更新版本。用户应该及时更新软件以确保其设备的安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: The CSRF protection mechanism implemented in the web administration panel on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices could be bypassed by omitting the CSRF token parameter in HTTP requests.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备中的 web 管理面板实现的 CSRF 防护机制存在漏洞，攻击者可以通过在 HTTP 请求中省略 CSRF token 参数来绕过该防护机制。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The CSRF protection mechanism implemented in the web administration panel on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices could be bypassed by omitting the CSRF token parameter in HTTP requests."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备 NSDP 协议认证方法存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，远程未经身份验证的攻击者可强制设备重启。
RECORDS.solution: 该漏洞已经被 NETGEAR 公司确认，并发布了修复程序。建议用户尽快更新相关设备的固件版本，以减少受到攻击的风险。此外，用户也可以使用其他认证方式来代替 NSDP 协议认证方法，以提高设备的安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the NSDP protocol authentication method on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices allows remote unauthenticated attackers to force a device reboot.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: NSDP 协议认证方法是 NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备的一种认证方式。由于该方式存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，远程未经身份验证的攻击者可通过恶意提交特定请求触发溢出漏洞，从而强制设备重启，导致服务中断。因此，攻击者可以利用该漏洞对受影响的设备造成拒绝服务 (DoS) 攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A buffer overflow vulnerability in the NSDP protocol authentication method on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices allows remote unauthenticated attackers to force a device reboot."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2设备上的NSDP协议实现未正确验证发送的写请求中字符串参数的长度，可能导致拒绝服务攻击。
RECORDS.solution: NETGEAR已经发布了修补程序，建议用户尽快升级到最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: The NSDP protocol implementation on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices was not properly validating the length of string parameters sent in write requests, potentially allowing denial of service attacks.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2设备上的NSDP协议实现存在漏洞，攻击者可以利用该漏洞发送过长的字符串参数来使设备意外关闭，从而引发拒绝服务攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The NSDP protocol implementation on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices was not properly validating the length of string parameters sent in write requests, potentially allowing denial of service attacks."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备允许未经身份验证的用户通过发送相应的写请求命令修改交换机 DHCP 配置。
RECORDS.solution: 用户可通过升级到最新的固件版本来修复该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices allow unauthenticated users to modify the switch DHCP configuration by sending the corresponding write request command.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞存在于 NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备中，攻击者可通过发送特定的 write request 命令修改交换机 DHCP 配置，造成安全隐患。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices allow unauthenticated users to modify the switch DHCP configuration by sending the corresponding write request command."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备访问控制中的缓冲区溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 该漏洞可以通过更新设备的最新固件版本来修复。
RECORDS.description_main: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the access control section on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices (in the administration web panel) allows an attacker to inject IP addresses into the whitelist via the checkedList parameter to the delete command.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞存在于NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43设备的管理Web界面的访问控制部分中，攻击者可以通过delete命令的checkedList参数将IP地址注入到白名单中。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A buffer overflow vulnerability in the access control section on NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 devices (in the administration web panel) allows an attacker to inject IP addresses into the whitelist via the checkedList parameter to the delete command."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR JGS516PE/GS116Ev2 v2.6.0.43 设备管理面板中的跨站脚本漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级设备上的软件版本至最新版本，并确保设备已正确配置和安全设置，以避免类似漏洞的出现。此外，管理员可以通过禁用管理面板对未经验证的用户访问和强制使用HTTPS等方法来加强设备的安全性。

RECORDS.title_zh: Dell EMC网络设备存在信息泄漏漏洞
RECORDS.solution: Dell EMC建议用户参考安全公告EMC374211，升级X系列和PC5500网络设备的固件版本至版本3.1.1.6及更高版本，升级VRTX交换模块的固件版本至版本2.0.0.78及更高版本。
RECORDS.description_main: Dell EMC Networking X-Series firmware versions 3.0.1.2 and older, Dell EMC Networking PC5500 firmware versions 4.1.0.22 and older and Dell EMC PowerEdge VRTX Switch Modules firmware versions 2.0.0.77 and older contain an information disclosure vulnerability. A remote unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to retrieve sensitive data by sending a specially crafted request to the affected endpoints.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Dell EMC Networking X系列固件版本3.0.1.2及更早、Dell EMC Networking PC5500固件版本4.1.0.22及更早以及Dell EMC PowerEdge VRTX交换模块固件版本2.0.0.77及更早存在信息泄漏漏洞。远程未经身份认证的攻击者可以利用此漏洞通过向受影响的终端发送特制请求来检索敏感数据。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Dell EMC Networking X-Series firmware versions 3.0.1.2 and older, Dell EMC Networking PC5500 firmware versions 4.1.0.22 and older and Dell EMC PowerEdge VRTX Switch Modules firmware versions 2.0.0.77 and older contain an information disclosure vulnerability. A remote unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to retrieve sensitive data by sending a specially crafted request to the affected endpoints."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: NETGEAR交换机（GS716Tv2 Firmware版本5.4.2.30及之前，GS724Tv3 Firmware版本5.4.2.30及之前）存在跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过未指定的向量劫持管理员的身份验证并通过接管设备的设置。
RECORDS.solution: 建议管理员及时升级至新版本的Firmware。同时，限制对设备的物理访问，并确保访问控制列表（ACL）有效，只允许经过身份验证和授权的用户进行访问。
RECORDS.description_main: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in NETGEAR switching hubs (GS716Tv2 Firmware version 5.4.2.30 and earlier, and GS724Tv3 Firmware version 5.4.2.30 and earlier) allow remote attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and alter the settings of the device via unspecified vectors.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许未经授权的远程攻击者通过执行恶意代码在受影响的设备上执行操作。攻击者可以以管理员身份执行命令、查看和修改敏感信息、创建新帐户或完全关闭设备。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in NETGEAR switching hubs (GS716Tv2 Firmware version 5.4.2.30 and earlier, and GS724Tv3 Firmware version 5.4.2.30 and earlier) allow remote attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and alter the settings of the device via unspecified vectors."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: GS108Ev3固件版本2.06.10及更早版本中存在跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞，允许远程攻击者劫持管理员的身份验证，并且产品的设置可能会在未经用户意图或同意下发生更改，具体来源未指定。
RECORDS.solution: 推荐使用最新的GS108Ev3固件版本，并避免点击未知来源的链接。此外，可以在浏览器中启用CSRF防御措施，如SameSite cookie属性和CSRF令牌。
RECORDS.description_main: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in GS108Ev3 firmware version 2.06.10 and earlier allows remote attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and the product's settings may be changed without the user's intention or consent via unspecified vectors.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: GS108Ev3固件版本2.06.10及更早版本中存在跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞，允许远程攻击者劫持管理员的身份验证，并且产品的设置可能会在未经用户意图或同意下发生更改，具体来源未指定。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in GS108Ev3 firmware version 2.06.10 and earlier allows remote attackers to hijack the authentication of administrators and the product's settings may be changed without the user's intention or consent via unspecified vectors."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: 发现 Netgear 产品的可利用固件修改漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 对于受影响的用户，请立即升级到最新可用的固件版本，以确保设备的安全性。此外，建议避免使用公共网络或未受信任的 Wi-Fi 热点，并仅从官方网站下载固件文件。
RECORDS.description_main: An exploitable firmware modification vulnerability was discovered in certain Netgear products. The data integrity of the uploaded firmware image is ensured with a fixed checksum number. Therefore, an attacker can conduct a MITM attack to modify the user-uploaded firmware image and bypass the checksum verification. This affects WNR612v2 Wireless Routers 1.0.0.3 and earlier, DGN1000v3 Modem Router 1.0.0.22 and earlier, D6100 WiFi DSL Modem Routers 1.0.0.63 and earlier, WNR1000v2 Wireless Routers 1.1.2.60 and earlier, XAVN2001v2 Wireless-N Extenders 0.4.0.7 and earlier, WNR2200 Wireless Routers 1.0.1.102 and earlier, WNR2500 Wireless Routers 1.0.0.34 and earlier, R8900 Smart WiFi Routers 1.0.3.6 and earlier, and R9000 Smart WiFi Routers 1.0.3.6 and earlier.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在某些 Netgear 产品中发现了一个可利用的固件修改漏洞。上传固件映像文件的数据完整性使用固定的校验和数字进行确保。因此，攻击者可以进行 MITM 攻击来修改用户上传的固件映像，并绕过校验和验证。这影响 WNR612v2 无线路由器 1.0.0.3 及早期版本、DGN1000v3 调制解调器路由器 1.0.0.22 及早期版本、D6100 WiFi DSL 调制解调器路由器 1.0.0.63 及早期版本、WNR1000v2 无线路由器 1.1.2.60 及早期版本、XAVN2001v2 无线 N 扩展器 0.4.0.7 及早期版本、WNR2200 无线路由器 1.0.1.102 及早期版本、WNR2500 无线路由器 1.0.0.34 及早期版本、R8900 智能 WiFi 路由器 1.0.3.6 及早期版本，以及 R9000 智能 WiFi 路由器 1.0.3.6 及早期版本。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An exploitable firmware modification vulnerability was discovered in certain Netgear products. The data integrity of the uploaded firmware image is ensured with a fixed checksum number. Therefore, an attacker can conduct a MITM attack to modify the user-uploaded firmware image and bypass the checksum verification. This affects WNR612v2 Wireless Routers 1.0.0.3 and earlier, DGN1000v3 Modem Router 1.0.0.22 and earlier, D6100 WiFi DSL Modem Routers 1.0.0.63 and earlier, WNR1000v2 Wireless Routers 1.1.2.60 and earlier, XAVN2001v2 Wireless-N Extenders 0.4.0.7 and earlier, WNR2200 Wireless Routers 1.0.1.102 and earlier, WNR2500 Wireless Routers 1.0.0.34 and earlier, R8900 Smart WiFi Routers 1.0.3.6 and earlier, and R9000 Smart WiFi Routers 1.0.3.6 and earlier."}]}

NETGEAR RAX30 logCtrl Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR RAX30 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the logCtrl action. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-19825.

End users can use this to upload modified, unofficial, and potentially malicious firmware to the device."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Netgear Nighthawk Wifi6 Router (RAX30) 存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: Netgear 通过更新固件修复了这个漏洞。用户应该立即更新他们的设备来消除风险。同时，还可以限制与 Router 通信的网络流量，以减少攻击者的风险。
RECORDS.description_main: Any request send to a Netgear Nighthawk Wifi6 Router (RAX30)'s web service containing a “Content-Type” of “multipartboundary=” will result in the request body being written to “/tmp/mulipartFile” on the device itself. A sufficiently large file will cause device resources to be exhausted, resulting in the device becoming unusable until it is rebooted.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 当一个包含 'Content-Type' 为 'multipartboundary=' 的请求发送到 Netgear Nighthawk Wifi6 Router（RAX30）的 web 服务时，请求体会被写入到设备本身的 '/tmp/mulipartFile' 中。如果文件足够大，设备的资源就会被耗尽，导致设备无法使用，需要重启才能恢复。
